search_space.definition: Native structural atoms with integer functional parameters and compatible two/three-factor products; original empirical controls and spending structure retained.
search_space.legacy_settings_fields: prediction_settings retains the unchanged legacy cache provenance. Its complexity.max_network_effects and PR-only fitness fields do not govern multiobjective-v1; this protocol and the schema-v2 decoder do.
search_space.scientific_constraints: Native compatibility, canonical aliases, proportional symmetric estimation-moment exclusions, complete forecast reparameterization and the unchanged estimation acceptance criteria.

research_question: Can ShinkaEvolve discover interpretable alternative network-selection specifications that improve forecasts of defense-cooperation agreements and defense spending relative to Kinne and Kang's Model 3?

objectives.J1: mean(candidate PRROC auc.integral - reference PRROC auc.integral)
objectives.J2: mean(reference tie Brier score - candidate tie Brier score)
objectives.J3: mean(reference ordinal-spending RMSE - candidate ordinal-spending RMSE)
objectives.failure_policy: Invalid evaluation; no fabricated objective vector, scalar fitness or partial-year mean.

auxiliary_score.purpose: Stable operational preference for native scalar bandit and prompt credit; never a replacement for Pareto population selection.
auxiliary_score.scaling: Ten is the range of the eleven ordinal spending categories. Equal theoretical ranges do not establish equal practical influence.

selection.dominance: No worse on all three objectives and strictly better on at least one.
selection.retention: Preserve every valid canonical nondominated model; use nondominated rank and objective-space diversity for active retention and parent selection.
selection.islands: The same objectives and Pareto rule apply to every island; migration preserves scientific trade-offs.

finalist_selection.source: Valid, distinct mathematical specifications on the development Pareto frontier.
finalist_selection.fresh_development_randomness: Freeze membership, then reforecast representatives and reference using configs/finalist-reporting-v1.json: target_year*1000+offset for offsets 2,3,4,5,6; reuse accepted fits and 1000 endpoints per target.
finalist_selection.sensitivity_interpretation: Five prespecified additional forecast-seed repetitions describe limited Monte Carlo sensitivity. No change to membership or evolutionary fitness; fitting uncertainty is not estimated.
finalist_selection.campaign_boundary: A session or execution-window boundary does not itself end the scientific campaign or trigger final-year access.

reproduction.reference: Original predictive Model 3, with its controls, spending-equation structure and native joint estimation retained.
reproduction.coefficients: All coefficients, including spending coefficients, are statistically reestimated for each candidate.
reproduction.reserved_outcome_ordering: New full-period Model 3/4 reproduction results involving 2010 must not enter mutation, selection or evaluator redesign before final selection is frozen.
reproduction.interpretation: The authors favor efficiency in their Model 4 comparison. Predictive gains in this Model 3-based extension do not independently establish efficiency, greater security or optimal partnership policy.
